thread:
lila: Heads-up: tentative cutover tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC. runtime v2.4.0 (kernel batching opt) + api v2.0.0 (minor header addition). Plan: 3-stage canary (2%, 20%, 100%). Router and console need a short pin until we validate post-warmup.

ravi: Acknowledged. Can you confirm api v2.0.0 is backwards compatible for current clients? Any client lib bump required?

lila: Backwards compatible. New header X-RW-Debug is optional. Console can safely show it if present. No immediate client bump required.

emily: Router note: prefer gradual header-split instead of abrupt. We'll run split 98/2 -> 80/20 -> 0/100. Keep header-split flag on until 100% to allow fast steering. Also will monitor route-error-rates and route-5xx-by-variant.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: initiating stage 1 canary (2%)
```
deploy --svc runtime --image runtime:v2.4.0 --canary=2% --meta tag=canary-7678
deploy --svc api --image api:v2.0.0 --canary=2% --meta tag=canary-7678
```
ETA ~4m for stage 1. Emitting events: canary_stage_started, canary_stage_ok, canary_stage_failed.

sre-runbook-bot: Adding automated checks: abort if error_rate > 1.0% OR p95_latency > 400ms for >3 consecutive minutes. Also check kernel-batch-miss rate delta.

emily: Also watch cold-start mem pressure during first 8 minutes. If mem climbs >85% we throttle ramp.

ravi: Quick preflight: smoke tests pass on staging; compatibility harness shows no header parsing failures.

deploy-bot: canary_stage_ok (ts: 7678910400) - stage 1 healthy per hooks.

lila: Ramp to stage 2 (20%). Update router split now.

deploy-bot: updating canary -> 20%
```
split-router --service api --variant new=20% --variant old=80% --tag canary-7678
```

emily: Split applied. Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood/ops/dash/deploy-7678

sre-runbook-bot: Observed transient bump in runtime/kernel-batch-miss from 0.3% to 1.1% during warmup, recovered to 0.4%. No action.

ravi: During 20% run we saw a handful of 500s from an edge shard (5 instances). Root cause suspected bad kv-priming race on new runtime.

lila: Ops alert: can we mitigate by priming kv cache per-shard? Could we force a short grace window to warm up?

emily: We can throttle ramp and add a priming job:
```
priming-job --service runtime --variant new --concurrency 10 --duration 2m
```
I'll run it now.

deploy-bot: priming job started (ts: 7678911200)

sre-runbook-bot: After priming, 500s dropped to baseline. Proceeding with slow ramp.

lila: Good catch. Update rollout plan: pause 10m after priming, then move to 50% for 10m then full.

emily: Also keep console pin active until final 100% complete. Router team will keep header-split feature flag on for quick revert.

deploy-bot: ramping to 50% (ts: 7678914000)

ravi: During 50% run p95 latency rose 30ms on long-tail; still within SLO. Error rate steady at 0.4%.

sre-runbook-bot: SLOs green. All canary gates satisfied.

lila: Proceed to final rollout in waves. Reminder: if any sustained error rate > 1.5% during final ramp, ops triggers rollback.

emily: Router: we'll keep an emergency route cut command ready: `routerctl cutover --to old --force` and console pin rollback script available.

deploy-bot: final_rollout_started (ts: 7678918000) - rolling out to 100% in 4 waves.

emily: Wave 2 completed, wave 3 in progress. Watching 5xx by region.

sre-runbook-bot: Small increase in kernel-batch-miss in wave 3 (0.6% -> 1.5%) but not correlated with errors. Continue watch.

ravi: We observed a client that surfaced the optional header in logs but no functional degradation.

deploy-bot: rollout_wave_complete (ts: 7678919400) - wave 4 starting.

emily: Wave 4 finished, metrics stable.

deploy-bot: rollout_complete (ts: 7678919900) - success. All gates passed.

lila: Thanks — I will publish the release notes: runtime v2.4.0 (kernel batching improvements, KV priming fix), api v2.0.0 (optional X-RW-Debug header). Release doc: https://docs.internal/releases/7678

emily: Unpin scheduled in 20m unless a rollback is requested.

ravi: Recommend we keep monitoring kv-priming metrics for next 2 hours. I'll log follow-up item.

sre-runbook-bot: Change window closed. If anyone observed anomalies, please add notes to incident tracker.

lila: Closing thread. Great job everyone. :party_popper:
